title: Pricing Tile Orchestra — Token Horizon: layered attribution & export prototype
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Design a compact, composable tile-based UI (Pricing Tile Orchestra) for the Redwood Console that surfaces token-level cost rollups and traceable attribution from rollup -> route -> invocation. The goal is a single-pane tile that supports: 1) progressive disclosure (summary -> detailed trace), 2) inline export (CSV/NDJSON) scoped to selection, 3) quick pricing simulations applying different ratecards, and 4) tie-outs to the Rollouts/Routes dashboard for per-model routing costs. This work covers wireframes, high-fidelity prototype, accessible tokenization visualization, and handoff-ready component specs. Deliverables: Figma prototype with interactive drill paths, export microflow spec, accessibility contrast/accessibility text, and a short validation plan for a design critique with PM/Eng. Key constraints: must fit within existing Console grid system (tile 1x2 or 2x1), be performant on data-heavy accounts (10k invocations/day), and offer clear guardrails for downstream export size and sampling.
acceptance_criteria: Tile renders summary row with total token cost and sparkline for 30d
Clicking 'Drill' expands a left-side trace panel showing route -> model -> invocation rows with token counts
Export action opens modal to choose scope (current view / time slice / selection), preview first 50 rows, and supports CSV + NDJSON
Pricing simulation overlay allows selecting a ratecard and shows delta in top-level summary without persisting changes
Component tokens (colors, spacings, typography) reference console-design-system v3 and include a11y text
comments: 2026-02-16 — Aisha G: Initial kickoff with PM (Sofia Chen) and Eng (Evan Brooks). Agreed scope: tile must support both per-route and per-model views. Asked Eng for time-series sample payloads (Evan) by 2026-02-18.

2026-02-22 — Marco H: First wireframes shared in Figma. PM requested a compact/expanded toggle for customers with dense route lists. Note: engineering flagged potential performance issue with live expansion for >1k routes; recommend sampling on initial load.

2026-02-28 — Evan B (Eng): Provided sample API responses and advised to limit detailed KV cache previews to 200 rows to avoid memory spikes. Suggested server-side pagination for drill-expand; design to include pagination controls.

2026-03-03 — Design critique: Recommended color palette change for cost bands to improve perceivability for users with deuteranopia. Updated token gradient and added patterned fill for export previews per accessibility review.

2026-03-07 — PM review (Sofia C): Approved the export microflow but requested an explicit warning about PII when exports include prompt text. Added requirement to mask or hash prompt text by default in exports and include a user toggle to include raw prompts with an audit log entry.

2026-03-09 — Handoff notes: Component specs completed for compact tile, expanded trace panel, export modal, and pricing-sim overlay. Generated Storybook stories and annotated Figma with accessibility tokens. Next steps: Eng to evaluate pagination UX and ETA for backend export sampling (Evan).
design_decisions: Prefer server-side sampling + client pagination for drill panels to avoid large client payloads
Mask prompt text in default exports and surface a clear audit/consent step for including raw_prompts
Use token-gradient palette with patterned fills to encode non-color channels for accessibility
usability_notes: Prototype tested with 5 internal PMs and 3 power-users from customer success; main feedback was need for a persistent filter bar for route/tag scoping
Include keyboard-first interactions for drill expansion and export modal (enter/space to open, esc to close)
qa_checks: Tile sizing respects grid breakpoints: 1x2 on small dashboards, 2x1 on expanded lists
Export preview shows first 50 rows and a size estimate for full scope
Pricing-sim overlays do not mutate persisted ratecards until user confirms
estimated_effort_notes: Design + proto: 5 pts. Eng backend changes (export sampling + mask toggle): 8-13 pts. Frontend tile/pagination: 5-8 pts.
final_delivery: Figma prototypes (link above), Storybook components branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/compare/pricing-tile-orchestra, design spec in Confluence
